D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Cyndi Munson runs furthest behind in Washington, McClain, Le Flore. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

The forecast's worst groups for Cyndi Munson: Immigration voters 21 to 77, Small counties 32 to 66, Incomes $125K and up 40 to 58. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
